headline: Contested Fronts See Fresh Base Turnover
war_summary: Since the last edition, the movement column has shifted unevenly. WeatheredExpanseHex has strengthened its claim as the busiest unsettled front, recording seventeen base events in twenty-four hours and nine in six, with six Warden-held bases against three Colonial. FarranacCoastHex also shows fresh motion—seven daily events, including two in the latest two hours—and now lists one Warden, nine Colonial, and one neutral base. FishermansRowHex records six events, two recent, while its line stands at one Warden base and eight Colonial. The great struggles at LinnMercyHex and StonecradleHex remain important but have cooled at the immediate edge: Linn shows seventeen daily events, down from the previous edition’s twenty-two, and Stonecradle thirteen against fourteen previously, with neither logging a fresh event in two hours. Stonecradle remains divided at three Warden to six Colonial. StlicanShelfHex, still split five to four, has five daily events but no new turnover in the latest six hours. Elsewhere the ledgers are largely quiet, leaving the next day’s clearest ownership uncertainty concentrated in these contested sectors.
